verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a physical business address with incoming mail scanning and recycling, plus registered agent service. Nothing in the evidence describes forwarding original documents under a documented policy, or how certified mail or checks are handled. "Send via paper mail" reads as outbound mailing of digitized files, and scan-and-recycle mail handling is an adjacent capability, not forwarding of originals.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, original documents are forwarded under a documented policy, so certified mail and checks reach the company
